mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN pf.authorize_workspace_actor(#{actor.userId},#{actor.spaceId}) THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.space WHERE id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND type='PERSONAL') ELSE false END
SELECT 1 FROM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('r62:connector-credential:'||CAST(#{actor.spaceId} AS text)||':'||CAST(#{actor.userId} AS text),0))
SELECT id,revision,state,created_at,request_fingerprint FROM pf.connector_credential WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND request_id=#{request}
SELECT id,revision,state,created_at FROM pf.connector_credential WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,revision,state,created_at FROM pf.connector_credential WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND id>#{after} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT credential_id,expected_revision,result_revision FROM pf.connector_credential_revocation WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND request_id=#{request}
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.connector_credential SET state='REVOKED',revision=revision+1 WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND id=#{id} AND revision=#{expected} AND state='ACTIVE'
